label: Favouring determination: the real determination that the bearer's own favouring is the profile φ
definition: favours φ is the real determination (DEF-REAL-DETERMINATION) of a bearer whose own favouring, in every variation scenario, is the profile φ: which candidate it counts in favour of over which. There is one token per profile. It is the bearer's own inclination, not a favouring supplied by another determiner and not a description of what the bearer happens to produce.
note: Stipulative analyst notion (#2145 Investigation 4), attribution deferred. Lean has no declaration for it: it is the parameter favours : Profile S X → D. Its content enters only through the open bridge OneFavouringRealization. That an original source's favouring is its own (condition E3 of ORIGINAL_FINALITY_1) is what makes commitment (e) supply such a determination.
